homeHelp: Accept marks the department sent, archive the roster, and issue transcripts. A correction or an unlock waits for the principal.
inboxHelp: A mark appears here after the department head sends it. Accepting is the record office step. Sending alone does not accept it.
queueHelp: Grade 12 requests move one step: submitted, in review, ready, collected. Ready issues the verification code.
transcriptHelp: A transcript uses the accepted marks of the student's year. A cumulative record uses every accepted year.
archiveHelp: Archiving stores the accepted roster and locks that section. New marks stay out until the principal grants an unlock.
correctionHelp: An accepted mark changes only after the principal grants that request. The old score stays in the access log.
importHelp: Excel is saved as CSV. A PDF is filed on the student profile, not read as a list. A structured file is JSON.
staffHelp: Credentials, work history, and file notes stay with the staff member.
filesHelp: A scanned PDF is stored with the student. It is not opened by a public link. The verification page checks the code only.
alumniHelp: Only grade 12 can be recorded as alumni. Filter by name, graduation year, or gender.
exportHelp: Accepted marks or alumni. Excel is a CSV file. Print uses the Ethiopic font on this page.
accessHelp: Every accept, issue, archive, correction, unlock, import, and export is written here. A log row cannot be deleted.
overrideHelp: Grant or refuse a correction or an unlock. A grant needs a written note. The record office then applies it.
verifyHelp: Enter the code printed on the transcript. A match shows who it was issued for. It does not show the marks.
verifyMissing: That code was not issued by this school system.
subject: Subject
title: Title
name: Name
noStudentsHelp: Import a CSV or a structured file, then come back to this list.
noStaffHelp: Staff accounts are added on staff registration. Come back after a staff member exists.
noMarksHelp: Accept a mark the department head has sent, then request a correction.
